title: RAW UNREVIEWED: one plant organ follows the sun or has a fixed compass orientation
summary: RAW_UNREVIEWED_NOT_SELECTED_NOT_TESTED. Search a dated botanical primary for an identified plant whose own words explicitly relate one visible organ's changing direction to the sun's movement, and keep separate any statement about a fixed east or west face. Only an admitted Voynich plant with a distinctive, independently owned directional feature and complete prose could become a target. Freeze source direction, time relation, and organ identity before comparison. A static illustration cannot establish motion, and a matching silhouette or modern plant behavior supplies no written meaning binding.

design.mechanism: one owned plant organ changes orientation with the sun rather than retaining one fixed direction
design.unit: one dated identified plant entry and one complete admitted botanical owner if found
design.contrast: time-dependent tracking versus fixed orientation versus decorative curvature
design.prediction: A candidate whole reading must express the source's time-indexed direction change on the same organ; one isolated direction word or curved drawing is insufficient.
design.scope: exploratory; no source or target owner selected
